description: This file defines the Style class responsible for writing style-related XML data in the XLSX format within PhpSpreadsheet. It includes methods for serializing styles, fonts, fills, borders, and other style components, as well as handling external style resources.

classes.name: Style
classes.description: Handles the serialization of style information to XML in the XLSX format, including fonts, fills, borders, and cell formats.

methods.name: writeStyles
methods.description: Serializes style components of a Spreadsheet object into XML format including fonts, fills, borders, and cell styles.

methods.name: writeFill
methods.description: Writes fill definitions to XML, handling both gradient and pattern fills.

methods.name: writeGradientFill
methods.description: Writes gradient fill specifics to XML.

methods.name: writePatternFill
methods.description: Writes pattern fill specifics to XML.

methods.name: writeFont
methods.description: Serializes font properties such as bold, italic, underline, color, size, and font name into XML.

methods.name: writeBorder
methods.description: Serializes border properties into XML, including styles and colors.

methods.name: writeCellStyleXf
methods.description: Writes cell style (xf) information, including alignment, font, fill, border, and protection settings.

methods.name: writeCellStyleDxf
methods.description: Serializes differential style (dxf) definitions, used for conditional formatting.

methods.name: writeBorderPr
methods.description: Serializes individual border properties used in border styles.

methods.name: writeNumFmt
methods.description: Writes number format definitions to XML.

methods.name: allStyles
methods.description: Returns all cell styles in the spreadsheet.

methods.name: allConditionalStyles
methods.description: Retrieves all conditional styles present in the spreadsheet.

methods.name: allFills
methods.description: Returns all unique fill styles used across the spreadsheet.

methods.name: allFonts
methods.description: Returns all unique font styles used across the spreadsheet.

methods.name: allBorders
methods.description: Returns all unique border styles used across the spreadsheet.

methods.name: allNumberFormats
methods.description: Returns all unique number formats used across the spreadsheet.
